description: This file implements the VoiceWakeManager class responsible for managing voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and related audio processing functionalities on iOS devices. It includes audio buffer handling, permission requests, and recognition result processing.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue that enqueues, drains, and clears audio buffers, supporting real-time audio processing.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake word detection, permissions, and speech recognition lifecycle, providing methods to start, stop, suspend, and handle recognition results asynchronously.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback for audio buffer tap that enqueues copied buffers into a queue.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer, supporting multiple data formats.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognition process with audio input and recognition task.

methods.name: tearDownRecognitionPipeline
methods.description: Cleans up and stops the recognition pipeline, releasing resources.

methods.name: makeRecognitionResultHandler
methods.description: Generates a handler for processing recognition results, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts commands based on recognized speech and trigger words.
